redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_usage_ledger.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 2 of 82 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - st1 (house FAIL), st2 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 79/82 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: usage_ledger.scan_transcripts now stamps every written row with the rate dict it was priced at (row['rate']), that rate's own effectiveFrom for a dated table row (None for a flat/legacy row), and the resolved table's own asOf/source (row['rateAsOf']/row['rateSource']), plumbed through new 'pricingAsOf'/'pricingSource' opts keys from meter-usage.py and audit-usage.py's --backfill. _usage_core.priced_at_read now prices a stamped row (one carrying a 'rate' key) from that stamp alone via a new _price_at_rate helper, never re-resolving it against whatever table a later reader hands in; an unstamped/legacy row is still priced again at read time but against the rate in effect ON ITS OWN hour-bucket date (bucket_date(row['ts'])) rather than 'now' - rates_for/_dated_row were split into _resolve_entry + _dated_row_with_from so the chosen dated row's own effectiveFrom could be recovered for the stamp (new public rate_for_stamp(model, pricing, at)). Haiku 5.5's published long-prompt tier (over 100,000 prompt tokens, billed at a materially higher rate incl. $0.05/MTok cache read vs $0.01) is now modelled: new tiered_model_key(model, context_tokens) classifies each message by its OWN prompt size (_context_of's in+cacheW5m+cacheW1h+cacheR) and groups/prices a long-prompt message under a distinct 'claude-haiku-5-5:long-prompt' key so one hour bucket never averages the two tiers; resolve_pricing lays this published row into every table it hands back (_with_long_prompt_tiers) without touching DEFAULT_PRICING itself, which stays pinned byte-for-byte against hooks/_config.py (pp8). An unpriced model's row now carries costUSD=None and unpriced=True instead of crashing scan_transcripts on round(None) (a real prior bug on the write path); _usage_core._add/_finish now sum an 'unpricedTokens' figure into totals()/aggregate() output, and audit-usage.py's dashboard prints 'unpriced' in the BY MODEL (and other grouped) tables via a new cost_cell() helper and names how many tokens the header's dollar total leaves out. Tests added: test_usage_ledger.py (st1/st2: a row's stamp survives a later table change; hk1/hk2/hk3: a 150,000-token Haiku 5.5 message lands in its own long-prompt row priced at 0.05/MTok cache read, a 50,000-token one in the same hour keeps 0.01), test__usage_core.py (rb1/rb2: an unstamped July/October row of a dated model price at different rows; rs1/rs2: a stamped row ignores a changed table, a stamp of None stays unpriced; ds1-ds3/lp1-lp6: rate_for_stamp and tiered_model_key/resolve_pricing's overlay directly), test_audit_usage.py (up1/up2: an unpriced model's row prints 'unpriced' and the total states the excluded token count). Verified: python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_usage_ledger.py --selftest -> ALL PASS 105/105; python3 plugins/audit/tests/test__usage_core.py --selftest -> ALL PASS 105/105; python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_usage.py --selftest -> ALL PASS 170/170; python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_meter_usage.py --selftest -> ALL PASS 49/49 (updated its a6 closed-field pin for the new stamp/unpriced keys); python3 plugins/audit/tests/test__report_usage.py and test__panel_usage.py --selftest unchanged and pass (106/106, 40/40) since those two files' own surfaces are P125.4's scope and were not touched. ruff check and vermin -t=3.8- clean on every changed file. Full project sweep (python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py) in this tree: 331/331 files ok, 152 migrated to tests/, 15885 cases, exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: Usage ledger rows now carry a permanent rate stamp immune to later price-table changes, Haiku 5.5's published long-prompt tier is priced per message instead of ignored, and an unpriced model's spend is shown rather than silently crashing the write path or vanishing from the total.
